## Full Stack Engineer

#### Dublin, Ireland

Three years shipping production web applications for **enterprise and
government clients**. I work across the stack with
[**React**](https://react.dev) and [**Next.js**](https://nextjs.org) on the
front, [**Node.js**](https://nodejs.org), [**Python**](https://www.python.org),
[**Django**](https://www.djangoproject.com), and
[**FastAPI**](https://fastapi.tiangolo.com) on the back.

I care about type safety, clean APIs, and interfaces that feel fast on a
mid-range laptop — not just on the demo machine.

[View Projects](projects/list/){.btn .btn-primary .btn-lg .me-2 role="button"}
[About Me](about.qmd){.btn .btn-outline-primary .btn-lg role="button"}

:::

:::{.grid}

:::{.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}

#### [{{< bi laptop >}}]{.text-primary} &nbsp; Frontend
Pixel-accurate UIs in **React** and **Next.js**. TypeScript everywhere,
accessibility baked in, performance budgets enforced. I care about the
90th-percentile user, not the best-case demo.
:::
:::
:::

:::{.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}
::: {.card .h-100 .border-0 .shadow-sm}
::: {.card-body}
#### [{{< bi hdd-stack >}}]{.text-primary} &nbsp; Backend
Scalable APIs in **Node.js** and **Python**. **Django** for batteries-included
web apps, **FastAPI** for async, typed endpoints that ship with OpenAPI docs
for free.
:::
:::
:::

:::{.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}
::: {.card .h-100 .border-0 .shadow-sm}

#### [{{< bi graph-up >}}]{.text-primary} &nbsp; Data & ML
When the product needs more than CRUD — I reach for **pandas**,
**scikit-learn**, and **Plotly** to turn raw data into decisions and
visualisations that stakeholders actually use.
